title: Block coordinates of a tape position
statement: For $N\in\mathbb{N}$, $z\in\mathbb{Z}$, and an offset $j\in\{0,\ldots,N\}$, the position $p=(N+1)z+j$ lies in block $z$ at offset $j$: its quotient on division by $N+1$ is $z$, and its remainder is $j$.
replaced:
For every $N \in \mathbb{N}$, every $z \in \mathbb{Z}$, and every
$j \in \{0,\dots,N\}$, the position $p = (N+1)z + j$ satisfies
$\lfloor p/(N+1) \rfloor = z$ and $p \bmod (N+1) = j$.
